data.description:
## Background Orphan git worktrees accumulate at `/Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra-worktrees/` across sprint and debug sessions. After a long-running sprint, ~50 orphans were found (~43 `agent-*` worktrees + several `worktree-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS` session worktrees + 3 filesystem-only orphan directories). Manual cleanup requires `git worktree remove -f -f` (double-force for locked worktrees). **Source bug:** d5c1-86a1-e4e8-4b4c (WorktreeLifecycle: sprint/agent task completion -> orphan worktrees not pruned) ## Root cause (4 gaps, from investigation + opus review) 1. **Compaction orphan path** — sprint orchestrator's `auto-resume.md` recovery merges abandoned branches via `git merge --no-edit` but never calls `git worktree remove`. ~43 worktrees per long session. 2. **Conflict-queue orphan path** — `harvest-worktree.sh` non-zero exits retain worktrees "for investigation" with no cross-session cleanup mechanism. 3. **Abnormal-exit orphan path** — `claude-safe`'s `_offer_worktree_cleanup` requires interactive terminal AND `is_merged=1`. SIGURG/timeout/kill skips cleanup. 4. **Lock persistence** — Claude Code platform locks agent worktrees at creation. When harvest is never called, locks persist, requiring double-force. ## Plan (v3, opus pre-approved) ### Epic A: Mechanical Worktree Reconciliation (ships first) **A1. Stop-hook reconciliation pass** - File: `plugins/dso/hooks/dispatchers/stop.sh` - New `hook_worktree_reconcile` function reads `WORKTREE_TRACKING:start` ticket comments without matching `:complete` - For each merged branch: call `harvest-worktree.sh --cleanup-only` (see A2) - For each unmerged branch: emit ticket comment `ABANDONED_WORKTREE: path=

branch= reason=unmerged`, leave worktree alone - Logs to `~/.claude/logs/dso-hook-errors.jsonl` (bypass dispatcher's `exec 2>/dev/null`) - Sets `WORKTREE_REMOVAL_SKIP_PR_CHECK=1` + reason to bound wall-clock cost **A1b. SessionStart compaction reconciliation companion** - File: `plugins/dso/hooks/lib/session-misc-functions.sh` - New function `hook_post_compact_worktree_reconcile` registered alongside existing `hook_post_compact_review_check` - Same body as A1; fires on compaction return (Stop does NOT fire on compaction — verified) - Closes the dominant orphan accumulation path **A2. harvest-worktree.sh `--cleanup-only` flag** (dependency of A1, A1b, B2, B3) - Skips gate-artifact verification (lines 173-241) — explicit documented bypass - Skips `--is-ancestor` short-circuit (line 165) - Jumps directly to cleanup block (lines 337+) - Trap emits `WORKTREE_TRACKING:complete outcome=cleanup_only` (NOT `merged`) — prevents false attestations - Rejects empty/session-root `--worktree-path` **A3. harvest-worktree.sh patch capture before removal** - Ports `worktree-cleanup.sh:817-830`'s patch-capture pattern into harvest's pre-removal step - `git diff HEAD > ~/.worktree-backups/harvest--.patch` + `git diff --cached >> ...` + untracked-file dump - 30-day TTL for backups directory - **Only safety net for Stop-hook-driven removals of potentially-uncommitted state** **A4. Daily archive sweep** (enabled-by-default, NOT opt-in) - New file: `plugins/dso/scripts/worktree-archive-sweep.sh` - Walks worktree parent directory for filesystem-only orphans matching 4-prong predicate: 1. Directory matches `worktree-*` or `agent-*` pattern 2. Not in `git worktree list` output 3. `.git` file absent OR references non-existent gitdir 4. `find -type f -mtime -7 -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/.venv/*' -not -path '*/.tox/*' | head -1` returns empty - Archives to `~/.worktree-orphan-archive/-/` (NOT deletion) - Daily job invokes `--purge-archive` before sweeping (bounds growth) - Ships macOS launchd plist AND Linux systemd timer (cross-platform parity) - Audit log: `~/.claude-safe-cleanup.log` + `/.cleanup-audit.log` ### Epic B: Worktree Cleanup Safety Hardening (ships second; scope reduced after A1+A1b) **B1. harvest-worktree.sh ERR-trap unlock + early path resolution** - Move `_harvest_worktree_path` resolution to right after argument parsing - Add `git worktree unlock` in `_harvest_cleanup` ERR trap on non-zero exit - Covers all non-zero exit paths (exits 1, 2, 3, signal-induced) - No retention-semantics change - Independent of Epic A; can ship in either **B2. auto-resume.md safety-hardened cleanup** - Routes through `harvest-worktree.sh --cleanup-only` (A2) - Inherits A3's patch backup automatically - Excludes discarded/aborted path explicitly - Detached-worktree case: lookup returns empty, no removal attempted (safe) **B3. Phase F.6 reconciliation pass** - File: `plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md` - Reconciliation against `WORKTREE_TRACKING` comments (NOT iteration over `git worktree list`) - For merged branches: route through A2 - For unmerged branches: warning + `RETAINED_UNMERGED_WORKTREE:` ticket comment, NEVER force-remove - Defense-in-depth after A1+A1b ship — no longer load-bearing **B4. worktree-cleanup.sh `--reclaim-orphan-dirs --archive-only`** - Double-opt-in: `WORKTREE_RECLAIM_ORPHAN_DIRS=1` env var AND `--reclaim-orphan-dirs` flag AND `--archive-only` initially - Same 4-prong predicate as A4 - Archive-first (no deletion mode initially) - Provides CLI surface for A4's behavior ## Sequencing ``` Epic A: A2 -> A1 + A1b -> A3 -> A4 (logical build order) Epic B: B1 (independent) -> B2 + B3 (depend on A2/A3) -> B4 (cli surface for A4) ``` ## Safety guarantees (verified) - Patch backup before ANY `--force` removal via A3 (verified: not currently in harvest-worktree.sh; must be added) - All destructive paths through `assert_worktree_removable` (existing guard at `lib/worktree-removal-guards.sh`) - Compaction-orphan path covered mechanically via A1b (Stop does NOT fire on compaction; verified) - No false `outcome=merged` attestations via A2's distinct `outcome=cleanup_only` event - No `--force` on unmerged branches anywhere — unmerged paths emit `ABANDONED_WORKTREE:` / `RETAINED_UNMERGED_WORKTREE:` comments only - Archive growth bounded via A4's daily `--purge-archive` - Cross-platform parity via systemd timer alongside launchd plist ## Incremental implementation ladder (low-ceremony path) ``` Step 1: B1 + A3 (single commit, harvest-worktree.sh only) Step 2: A2 (--cleanup-only) (single commit, harvest-worktree.sh only) Step 3: B2 + B3 (skill edits, route through A2) Step 4: A1 + A1b (hook plumbing) Step 5: A4 + scheduling (cross-platform scheduler infrastructure) ``` After Step 3: ~80% of orphan-prevention coverage without hook or scheduler changes. ## References - Investigation report on bug d5c1-86a1-e4e8-4b4c - Opus review v1 (rejected Fix 3 as deletion; required architectural Stop hook addition) - Opus review v2 (identified 3 required modifications: patch backup claim was false; Stop hook compaction premise was false; `--cleanup-only` contract gaps) - v3 plan addresses all 3 required modifications ## Closure Checks - [ ] All four orphan-accumulation paths covered (compaction, conflict-queue, abnormal-exit, lock-persistence) - [ ] Patch backup verifiably created before every `--force` removal in harvest-worktree.sh - [ ] Stop-hook + SessionStart reconciliation paths verified by integration test (fake WORKTREE_TRACKING comments → expected cleanup actions) - [ ] Daily archive sweep verified on both macOS (launchd) and Linux (systemd) - [ ] No false `outcome=merged` events emitted from `--cleanup-only` invocations - [ ] Source bug d5c1-86a1-e4e8-4b4c closed with reference to this epic
data.title: Orphan worktree prevention: mechanical reconciliation + safety hardening
